maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The keypoints in the uppermost row (Row A) follow a linear horizontal trajectory positioned approximately 12-15 pixels superior to the primary dense row (Row B), with an inter-keypoint distance of roughly 1.3 times the mean spot diameter.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium surface exhibits approximately 97% dark (melanin) pixel saturation, with non-pigmented pixels limited to specular highlights and a minute area of pinkish-beige mottling at the central philtrum base.
